DCFR (Tabular Discounted CFR): Tree settings: board texture, bet sizes, stack depth, pot size, raise limits, position ranges
Deep PDCFR (VR-DeepPDCFR+): YAML config: game_name, num_episodes, num_traversals, alpha, gamma, network size (layers/hiddens), buffer sizes, epsilon
Key Difference: DCFR = configure the GAME TREE structure. Deep PDCFR = configure the LEARNING process

DCFR (Tabular Discounted CFR): Explicitly define every decision point: preflop ranges, flop/turn/river bet sizing tree (e.g. 33%/50%/75%/all-in)
Deep PDCFR (VR-DeepPDCFR+): Game loaded from OpenSpiel or custom NLHEGame class with MAX_ACTIONS=10 fixed action space
Key Difference: DCFR needs exact bet sizes upfront. Deep PDCFR uses fixed action abstraction the network learns over

DCFR (Tabular Discounted CFR): User manually prunes: fewer bet sizes = smaller tree = faster solve. Trade accuracy for speed
Deep PDCFR (VR-DeepPDCFR+): User controls num_traversals (sampling density) and num_episodes (total compute budget). Tree is never fully built
Key Difference: DCFR user must balance tree size vs accuracy. Deep PDCFR user balances training budget vs accuracy

DCFR (Tabular Discounted CFR): Select specific board (e.g. Ah Kd 7s flop) or batch of boards for a postflop spot
Deep PDCFR (VR-DeepPDCFR+): Configure game_name (KuhnPoker/LeducPoker/FHP) or custom NLHE subgame definition
Key Difference: DCFR solves ONE specific spot at a time. Deep PDCFR can learn across ALL spots simultaneously

DCFR (Tabular Discounted CFR): GUI settings in solver software (PioSOLVER/GTO+/MonkerSolver) or proprietary config files
Deep PDCFR (VR-DeepPDCFR+): YAML file (e.g. configs/VRDeepPDCFRPlus.yaml) + CLI overrides: python scripts/run.py with configs/VRDeepPDCFRPlus.yaml game_name=FHP
Key Difference: Commercial solver GUIs vs research code YAML configs

DCFR (Tabular Discounted CFR): Click 'Run' or 'Solve' in solver GUI. Solver builds full game tree in memory then iterates
Deep PDCFR (VR-DeepPDCFR+): python scripts/run.py with configs/VRDeepPDCFRPlus.yaml -- Sacred framework loads config and calls solver.solve()
Key Difference: DCFR = one-click GUI. Deep PDCFR = CLI command

DCFR (Tabular Discounted CFR): Full-tree traversal: visits EVERY node EVERY iteration. Updates regret table entry for each info set. CPU-bound
Deep PDCFR (VR-DeepPDCFR+): Sampling-based: DFS traverses random paths through tree (external sampling). Collects regret samples into buffer. Trains 4 neural nets on GPU
Key Difference: DCFR touches all nodes = exact but slow. Deep PDCFR samples subset = approximate but fast

DCFR (Tabular Discounted CFR): Each iteration: traverse full tree -> update regret[info_set][action] += cf_regret -> apply discount (t^alpha/(t^alpha+1)) -> regret match to get new strategy
Deep PDCFR (VR-DeepPDCFR+): Each iteration per player: (1) 10K DFS traversals collecting data -> (2) train cumulative regret net 750 steps -> (3) train immediate regret net -> (4) train baseline net -> (5) every 3 iters: train average policy net 5000 steps + evaluate
Key Difference: DCFR iteration = simple table update O(1) per node. Deep PDCFR iteration = neural net training (SGD) but visits far fewer nodes

DCFR (Tabular Discounted CFR): CPU only. Single-threaded or multi-threaded across nodes. RAM-bound by tree size
Deep PDCFR (VR-DeepPDCFR+): GPU for neural net training + forward passes. CPU for tree traversal. Vectorized: processes all 1326 combos per node in one GPU batch
Key Difference: DCFR = buy more RAM for bigger trees. Deep PDCFR = buy bigger GPU for faster training

DCFR (Tabular Discounted CFR): O(nodes x actions x combos) -- stores regret value for every (info_set, action) pair. Grows linearly with tree. FHP ~910K nodes feasible, NLHE impossible
Deep PDCFR (VR-DeepPDCFR+): O(network_params + buffer_size) -- fixed ~1M params + 150K regret buffer + 1M policy buffer. Does NOT grow with game size
Key Difference: DCFR memory explodes with game size. Deep PDCFR memory is constant regardless of game size

DCFR (Tabular Discounted CFR): Solver GUI shows: iteration count, current exploitability, estimated time remaining
Deep PDCFR (VR-DeepPDCFR+): Logs to data.csv every eval_frequency iterations: exploitability, regret_loss, nodes_touched, episode count
Key Difference: DCFR = visual progress bar. Deep PDCFR = CSV metrics file

DCFR (Tabular Discounted CFR): Exploitability drops below threshold (e.g. <0.5% pot). User watches it converge and stops
Deep PDCFR (VR-DeepPDCFR+): Exploitability logged every 3 iterations. User checks data.csv or plots learning curve. No auto-stop
Key Difference: Both track exploitability. DCFR has built-in stopping. Deep PDCFR requires manual monitoring

DCFR (Tabular Discounted CFR): Minutes to hours per specific board/spot depending on tree size and iterations
Deep PDCFR (VR-DeepPDCFR+): Hours to days for training across game. But ONE trained model covers ALL spots in that game type
Key Difference: DCFR = fast per spot but must solve EACH spot separately. Deep PDCFR = slow to train but ONE model serves ALL spots

DCFR (Tabular Discounted CFR): Binary file (.cfr, .pio, etc.) containing the COMPLETE regret tree with converged strategies at every node
Deep PDCFR (VR-DeepPDCFR+): PyTorch model weights (state_dict) for: (1) average policy network, (2) per-player regret networks, (3) baseline network. Plus data.csv metrics
Key Difference: DCFR = a FILE containing a TREE. Deep PDCFR = a FILE containing NETWORK WEIGHTS

DCFR (Tabular Discounted CFR): Proprietary binary format specific to solver (PioSOLVER .cfr, GTO+ .gto, MonkerSolver .monk)
Deep PDCFR (VR-DeepPDCFR+): PyTorch .pt checkpoint files (portable). Currently saved in-memory; can torch.save(model.state_dict(), 'model.pt')
Key Difference: DCFR = vendor-locked binary. Deep PDCFR = standard PyTorch format

DCFR (Tabular Discounted CFR): Large: proportional to tree size. Each node stores strategy[combos x actions]. Can be hundreds of MB to GB per spot
Deep PDCFR (VR-DeepPDCFR+): Small: fixed ~5-10 MB regardless of game size (network parameters only)
Key Difference: DCFR output scales with game. Deep PDCFR output is constant size

DCFR (Tabular Discounted CFR): Complete strategy for every (info_set, action) pair at every node in the solved tree. Also stores regrets and EV for analysis
Deep PDCFR (VR-DeepPDCFR+): Learned function: given any game state as input -> outputs action probabilities. Generalizes to states not seen during training
Key Difference: DCFR = lookup table (exact answers for solved nodes only). Deep PDCFR = learned function (approximate answers for ANY state)

DCFR (Tabular Discounted CFR): Iteration count + final exploitability shown in GUI
Deep PDCFR (VR-DeepPDCFR+): data.csv with columns: step, nodes_touched, iteration, episode, exp, timestamps, regret_loss_0/1, baseline_loss_0/1
Key Difference: Deep PDCFR provides richer training diagnostics

DCFR (Tabular Discounted CFR): Load binary file in solver GUI. Navigate the tree: click node -> see strategy (action frequencies per hand combo). Browse: flop -> turn -> river
Deep PDCFR (VR-DeepPDCFR+): Call model forward pass: ave_policy_trainer.action_probabilities(state) -> returns {action: probability} dict for that state
Key Difference: DCFR = visual tree browser. Deep PDCFR = programmatic API query

DCFR (Tabular Discounted CFR): Select node in tree -> filter by specific hand -> see exact strategy (e.g. AhKd bets 75% for 60% on Qs9h3c flop)
Deep PDCFR (VR-DeepPDCFR+): Encode game state as tensor (infostate_size features) -> feed to network -> get action distribution. Works for ANY hand on ANY board
Key Difference: DCFR = manual GUI navigation. Deep PDCFR = feed state tensor and get answer instantly

DCFR (Tabular Discounted CFR): Only the EXACT spots solved. Different board = solve again. Different bet size tree = solve again
Deep PDCFR (VR-DeepPDCFR+): ALL states in the game type the model was trained on. One model covers all boards/all hands/all lines
Key Difference: DCFR = solve each spot individually. Deep PDCFR = one model covers everything (the DEEP generalization advantage)

DCFR (Tabular Discounted CFR): Exact (up to convergence tolerance). The strategy IS the Nash equilibrium for that specific tree
Deep PDCFR (VR-DeepPDCFR+): Approximate. Bounded by neural network function approximation error. Good but not exact
Key Difference: DCFR = exact per spot. Deep PDCFR = approximate but covers infinitely more spots

DCFR (Tabular Discounted CFR): Instant lookup: strategy is pre-computed in the binary file. O(1) per query
Deep PDCFR (VR-DeepPDCFR+): Neural net forward pass: ~1ms on GPU, ~10ms on CPU. O(network_depth) per query
Key Difference: Both fast at query time. DCFR slightly faster (table lookup) but Deep PDCFR still real-time

DCFR (Tabular Discounted CFR): Solve every flop (1755 strategically distinct flops) x every turn card x every river card x every bet size tree = MILLIONS of individual solves
Deep PDCFR (VR-DeepPDCFR+): Train ONE model per game configuration. Model generalizes across all boards. Or train per-street models
Key Difference: DCFR = millions of individual solves = 3000 years. Deep PDCFR = handful of training runs

DCFR (Tabular Discounted CFR): Massive: millions of binary files x hundreds of MB each = hundreds of TB total
Deep PDCFR (VR-DeepPDCFR+): Compact: one set of model weights ~5-10 MB per configuration. Total library could be <1 GB
Key Difference: DCFR library = hundreds of TB. Deep PDCFR library = under 1 GB

DCFR (Tabular Discounted CFR): Must store and serve massive binary files. Each query requires loading the right file for that exact spot
Deep PDCFR (VR-DeepPDCFR+): Deploy model weights to cloud. Single model handles all queries via forward pass. Standard ML serving infrastructure
Key Difference: DCFR = massive storage + file routing. Deep PDCFR = standard ML model serving

DCFR (Tabular Discounted CFR): 3000 years CPU time benchmark. Even parallelized across cloud: enormous compute cost + storage cost
Deep PDCFR (VR-DeepPDCFR+): Orders of magnitude less: GPU training for days-weeks + minimal storage. Cloud GPU cost is manageable
Key Difference: This is the core value proposition of Deep PDCFR for your project

DCFR (Tabular Discounted CFR): Must re-solve every affected spot from scratch if bet sizing tree changes
Deep PDCFR (VR-DeepPDCFR+): Fine-tune existing model with additional training. Incremental updates possible
Key Difference: DCFR = start over. Deep PDCFR = continue training
